description: This file is a CMake module script for finding and configuring the Zephyr SDK within a build system. It manages environment variables, searches for SDK versions, and sets up necessary configurations for the Zephyr SDK integration.

methods.name: zephyr_get
methods.description: Retrieves environment variables related to Zephyr SDK configuration.

methods.name: find_package
methods.description: Searches for a package, such as Zephyr SDK, with specified version and configuration options.

methods.name: message
methods.description: Outputs status or error messages during the configuration process.

methods.name: include
methods.description: Includes another CMake script, such as host-tools.cmake, for additional configuration.
